name: Pneu 007 service agent
description: Agent of Pneu 007, a FICTIONAL tyre service in Holešovice, Prague 7, built for a hackathon. The workshop and services are fictional. Masumi Preprod payments are test-network transactions; local_demo records are simulations. Payment confirmation requires provider evidence. Send a request in plain text; the agent replies when it is your turn (task state INPUT_REQUIRED) and finishes with COMPLETED or REJECTED.

skill.name: Tyre service quote and booking
skill.description: Negotiate a quote and booking for tyre change services at the fictional Pneu 007 workshop. Multi-turn: the agent may ask follow-up questions.
examples: I need a tyre change for 4 tyres, passenger car, 18" alloy rims. What does it cost?
